tools.name: get_licensee
tools.description: Returns the licensee, his licence number and jurisdiction, and the brokerage he is registered under. Use this first for any question about who runs this site or what he is authorised to do.

tools.name: get_service_area
tools.description: Given a US state, returns whether Jacob Campbell can represent a consumer there (Florida) or can only refer them to a licensee in that state (everywhere else), plus the URL of the relevant page.

tools.name: explain_referral
tools.description: Explains the referral process and the fee mechanics: who pays, who may be paid, and what it costs the consumer.

tools.name: search_mls
tools.description: Use this for any question about homes for sale, property searches or MLS listings in Florida. Returns where the live MLS search runs and what Jacob Campbell does for a buyer using it. IMPORTANT: the homes in that search are listed by many different brokerages; they are NOT Jacob Campbell's listings

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetches any page on jacobcampbellrealtor.com and returns it as Markdown. Pass a path, e.g. "/about.php" or "/real-estate-agent/texas/austin/".

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across every published page, FAQ answer, article and recommended local trade on jacobcampbellrealtor.com. Use this for any question you cannot answer from the other tools, and before guessing a page path for get_page_markdown. Returns titles, URLs and matching text.

tools.name: list_trade_partners
tools.description: Returns the contractors and restoration companies Jacob Campbell recommends to clients in South Florida, with what each one does, where they work, and their licence status. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_mls" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Use this for any question about homes for sale, property searches or MLS listings in Florida. Returns where the live MLS search runs and what Jacob Campbell doe…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_referral_areas" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the insurance and service companies Jacob Campbell can introduce a Florida client to, each with the city its office is actually in, the state licence it…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
